notes.title: Routine Update Preview for February 21
notes.notes:
The garden is brilliantly lit by fireworks and a sea of lanterns; even the city gates have been opened.  The Lantern Festival is approaching. In this update, we sincerely invite you to participate in the Lantern Festival "Lantern Trivia" event. We wish you all a happy Lantern Festival, my Lords!

The game will undergo routine maintenance for the whole server at 16:00 (UTC+9) on February 21. 
click the link to learn more details:
https://www.infinitebordersgame.com/news/update/20240220/39304_1138859.html

notes.title: Hero Achievement Function Preview
notes.notes:
In the world of INFINITE BORDERS, there are many fierce generals and capable ministers who fight north and south with you, assisting you with the hegemonic ambition of uniting the Thirteen States. On this festive occasion, INFINITE BORDERS will introduce the "Hero Achievement" feature, click the link to view the details: [url=https://www.infinitebordersgame.com/news/update/20231017/39304_1115136.html]https://www.infinitebordersgame.com/news/update/20231017/39304_1115136.html[/url]
 Lords can unlock achievements for their Heroes, capturing moments of their shared journey of growth and commemorating the perilous quest for the throne.
